rationale_per_step.research-parse-corpus-eval: The redaction has one owner and one set of assertions, so the next item is the one the vision calls measurable quality: the parser that turns a fetched page into evidence is asserted against a few remembered examples, not against the shapes real pages take.
rationale_per_step.embedding-coverage-eval: Keep on slice for Hybrid search readiness / Measurable quality. Do not select while in flight (exclusion list).
rationale_per_step.research-observability: Keep on slice for research.run / research.schedule inspectability. Do not select while in flight (exclusion list).
rationale_per_step.search-ui: Keep on slice for URL-driven discovery UI. Do not select while in flight (exclusion list).

category_mix: Three maintenance and tech_debt runs in a row have paid down the security and caching debt around the reader-facing surfaces. Testing and observability is the category with the oldest thin spot: the parser has coverage of its collectors but not of its parse.
notes: Fixtures are checked in, so the corpus stays hermetic: no network, no clock, no environment.
